full_name: MOI RIS resident population by sex (現住人口數按性別、身分分), ODRP013

features.definition: Total resident population (現住人口數 總計), MOI RIS ODRP013, village granularity.
Male resident population (現住人口數 總計_男), MOI RIS ODRP013. Matches global_schema.json's malePopulation exactly.
Female resident population (現住人口數 總計_女), MOI RIS ODRP013. Matches global_schema.json's femalePopulation exactly.
Number of registered households (戶數), MOI RIS ODRP014 (村里戶數、單一年齡人口), village granularity, merged onto ODRP013 rows by district_code. Matches global_schema.json's households exactly.

Indigenous/aboriginal resident population (原住民人口, 平地原住民+山地原住民), MOI RIS ODRP013 -- sum of aborigine_plain_total_m/f and aborigine_mountain_total_m/f, computed in pycensus.countries.taiwan.moi.loader._fetch_all_villages. Matches global_schema.json's minorityEthnicityPopulation.

Resident population younger than 18, MOI RIS ODRP014 (村里戶數、單一年齡人口) -- sum of the real single-year age buckets people_age_000..people_age_017 (m+f), computed in pycensus.countries.taiwan.moi.loader._add_derived_age_columns. Matches global_schema.json's under18Population exactly.

Resident population aged 18 or older, MOI RIS ODRP014 -- sum of the real single-year age buckets people_age_018..people_age_100up (m+f), computed in pycensus.countries.taiwan.moi.loader._add_derived_age_columns. Matches global_schema.json's adultPopulation exactly.

Resident population aged 65 or older, MOI RIS ODRP014 -- sum of the real single-year age buckets people_age_065..people_age_100up (m+f), computed in pycensus.countries.taiwan.moi.loader._add_derived_age_columns. Matches global_schema.json's over65Population exactly. Live-verified for Taipei City 2026-08-22: 580,555 / 2,451,007 = 23.7% over-65 share, plausible against Taipei's well-documented, unusually old age structure.

Median age of the resident population, MOI RIS ODRP014 -- discrete weighted median computed directly from the real single-year age buckets people_age_000..people_age_100up (m+f) summed to the requested level (village/district/county_city/nation), in pycensus.countries.taiwan.moi.loader._weighted_median_age. Not simply averaged from lower-level medians (that would misweight small villages). The people_age_100up bucket is MOI's own top-coding (ages 100+), not an approximation. Matches global_schema.json's medianAge.
